# Requirement traceability

Specification: `hl7.fhir.eu.health-data-api@1.0.0-ballot`. Requirement source: https://build.fhir.org/ig/euridice-org/eu-health-data-api/en/regulatoryAnchors.html

**Status: draft: the covers mapping is an unreviewed judgement and must be confirmed by the specification owners.** Generated by `node scripts/build-traceability.mjs` from the `@covers` tags of the Gherkin features and `requirements.json`. Do not edit.

A requirement is listed as having tests when a scenario is *tagged* with a path that implements it. A step that asserts something without a matching tag (for example the bearer token the consumers present) is not counted.
